jobs.title: Recruiting Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 237803
Job Description

Cintas is seeking a Recruiting Strategy Manager (RSM) to develop and deliver recruitment strategy for a Cintas business division.  In this role you will be leading a team of Recruiters by providing day-to-day guidance and ongoing training and development that allows them to reach their highest potential; this includes doing job shadows, hosting monthly calls, and conducting weekly debriefs. As RSM you will work with regional leadership and each Recruiter to develop, implement and manage all recruiting programs to ensure effectiveness, consistency and compliance with the overall strategic talent acquisition vision.  Responsibilities of this role also include ensuring all Recruiters are executing sourcing strategies to proactively source candidates nationwide into open positions at Cintas.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership;  Manage a national team of Recruiters within a Cintas division ensuring that the team is focused, motivated, and inspired to achieve team objectives.

Individual Partner Development;  build the capability of others by teaching, coaching and/or mentoring them to do their highest potential.

Drive for Results;  Create and maintain weekly, monthly, and quarterly activity reports; prepare and submit various reports concerning productivity/activity focusing on assessing, measuring and improving performance.

Collaborative Influence;  Develop relationships with local, regional, and senior leadership with the ability to gain cross-divisional buy-in and partnership by influencing in all directions through all levels of partners and external contacts.

Action Planning;  Use comprehensive knowledge and skills to provide guidance and training to others on developing strategies and sources to enable Cintas to be an employer of choice nationwide

Subject Matter Expertise;  Apply knowledge and expertise to provide guidance and training to others on the use applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruiting software (SAP SuccessFactors, Indeed, LinkedIn) to source, recruit, and track candidates from the selection phase to onboarding

Skills/Qualifications

Required:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

- 3+ years experience in Talent Acquisition/Recruiting.

- Ability to travel up to 25%.

Preferred:

- 1+ year experience managing and supervising others to achieve specific end results within a given timeframe.

- Knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors and integrating vendors.

- Ability to run and analyze reports to gauge performance and return on investment for department spend.

Benefits
Cintas offers comprehensive and competitive medical, dental and vision benefits, with premiums below the national average. We offer flexibility with four different medical plan options; one plan is offered at zero cost.

Additionally, our employee-partners enjoy:

•    Competitive Pay
•    401(k) with Company Match/Profit Sharing/Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
•    Disability, Life and AD&D Insurance, 100% Company Paid
•    Paid Time Off and Holidays
•    Skills Development, Training and Career Advancement Opportunities

Company Information
Cintas Corporation helps more than one million businesses of all types and sizes get Ready™ to open their doors with confidence every day by providing products and services that help keep their customers’ facilities and employees clean, safe, and looking their best. With offerings including uniforms, mats, mops, towels, restroom supplies, workplace water services, first aid and safety products, eye-wash stations, safety training, fire extinguishers, sprinkler systems and alarm service, Cintas helps customers get Ready for the Workday®. Headquartered in the U.S., Cincinnati, OH, Cintas is a publicly held Fortune 500 company traded over the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol CTAS and is a component of both the Standard & Poor’s 500 Index and Nasdaq-100 Index.

Cintas Corporation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic or category protected by local, state, or federal law.

jobs.title: Marketing Technology Strategist
jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 232608
Job Description

Cintas is seeking a Marketing Technology Strategist to manage and optimize the performance, governance, and continuous improvement of the company's web properties. This role partners with Marketing, Analytics, IT, Security, and external development teams to deliver secure, scalable, measurable, and high-performing digital experiences that support lead generation, customer engagement, and business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own and optimize Cintas web properties, campaign destinations, forms, and website-based marketing technology to drive lead generation and conversion.

- Translate marketing, campaign, and customer journey needs into scalable website experiences and technology requirements.

- Manage CMS governance, publishing workflows, templates, components, and web standards to ensure consistency and efficiency.

- Lead website conversion optimization efforts, including landing pages, forms, personalization, testing, and buyer enablement tools.

- Manage external development partners, including backlog priorities, scope, timelines, quality assurance, and delivery accountability.

- Ensure website experiences are measurable through analytics, tagging, conversion tracking, and performance reporting.

- Oversee website integrations with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, personalization, DAM, chat, and other digital platforms.

- Coordinate website releases, platform dependencies, and issue resolution with IT, Security, Cloud, and development teams.

- Monitor website health, accessibility, SEO, performance, tracking accuracy, and user experience to identify and resolve issues.

- Provide subject matter expertise on web platform capabilities, best practices, feasibility, and future website or MarTech enhancements.

Skills/Qualifications

Required

- Minimum 6 years of experience in web platform management, digital experience delivery, marketing technology, or a related field

- Experience managing enterprise websites, CMS platforms, and digital initiatives that support lead generation and customer engagement

Preferred

- Experience with enterprise CMS platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Sitefinity, Sitecore, Drupal) and related technologies, including CRM, marketing automation, analytics, tagging, APIs, and web integrations

- Knowledge of B2B demand generation, conversion optimization, personalization, SEO, analytics, and digital customer journeys

- Experience managing external agencies, development partners, website releases, and cross-functional projects

- Strong project management, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills

jobs.description:

Job Description

Job Description:

Cintas is seeking a Six Sigma Black Belt I to lead process improvement initiatives and support data-driven operational decisions across our van-delivered service business. Utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies, analytics, and cross-functional collaboration, this role partners with operational leaders to identify opportunities to improve route efficiency, capacity utilization, productivity, customer service, and overall business performance.

Key Responsibilities:

•    Performing analytical and project leadership roles to complete improvement initiatives on time, achieve measurable results, and ensure sustainable gains
•    Evaluating route capacity, productivity, and operational performance data to identify improvement opportunities
•    Supporting route growth and optimization initiatives through analysis and recommendations
•    Developing and delivering training on Lean, Six Sigma, innovation, and change management methodologies
•    Facilitating workshops, assessments, and problem-solving sessions
•    Creating reports, dashboards, and business analyses to support decision-making
•    Partnering with corporate and field leaders to drive operational improvements

Skills/Qualifications

Required
•    High School Diploma/GED
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
•    Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
•    Advanced Excel skills and experience analyzing large data sets
•    Green Belt certification or equivalent
•    Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills
•    Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
•    Ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations
•    Ability to travel up to 25-40%, including overnight stays

Preferred:
•    Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Analytics, Finance, or related field
•    2+ years of experience with Six Sigma or equivalent methodologies, business analytics, process improvement, operational planning, or related experience
•    Experience supporting route optimization, capacity planning, territory planning, logistics, or service operations analytics
•    Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools
•    Experience building business cases and financial analyses
•    Experience teaching or facilitating classroom-based training
•    Strong facilitation and change management skills

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 233129
Job Description

Cintas is seeking an Operations Manager - Facility Services to profitably grow and maintain all of our Facility Service Business within a designated market. Responsibilities include leading and managing the overall sales and operations of our Facility Service business in order to meet company targets for retention, growth, profitability and overall customer satisfaction; directing all Facility Service partners by proper utilization of sound management practices and administration of Cintas policies and procedures in order to achieve defined goals.

Skills/Qualifications

Required

- High School Diploma/GED; Bachelor's degree in business or a related field preferred

- Ability to travel approximately 5% of the time, including overnight travel

Qualified candidates must meet all requirements outlined by the Department of Transportation (DOT) or Provincial requirements (Canada) for driving a regulated vehicle weighing more than 10,000 lbs.  In order to comply with DOT requirements, qualified candidates must, prior to their first day of employment:

- Have an active driver's license

- Be at least 21 years of age

- Obtain a DOT medical certification

- Provide documentation regarding their previous employment

Preferred

- 3-5 years' performance-driven management and/or sales experience

- Management experience in a service environment

Benefits
Cintas offers comprehensive and competitive medical, dental and vision benefits, with premiums below the national average. We offer flexibility with four different medical plan options; one plan is offered at zero cost.

Additionally, our employee-partners enjoy:

•    Competitive Pay
•    401(k) with Company Match/Profit Sharing/Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
•    Disability, Life and AD&D Insurance, 100% Company Paid
•    Paid Time Off and Holidays
•    Skills Development, Training and Career Advancement Opportunities

Compensation
A reasonable estimate of base salary for this role ranges between $99,000 - $128,700/Year and is eligible for an annual target bonus. The bonus earned is based on the performance of the individual, location, division, and/or company. The range takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, and other business and organization needs. Please note, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decision are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each decision.
